minutes.headline: School Committee heard FY19 budget requests from every school and department; no votes on them.
minutes.summary: Principals and directors presented FY19 budget requests for the primary school, Turkey Hill, middle school, high school, special services and athletics, with questions from members. Requests include added teachers, assistant principals, paraprofessionals, a social worker and associate coaches. A resident questioned the athletic coaches line, and the superintendent agreed to review and repost it. The only votes were procedural.

public_comment.topic: Questioned the athletic director salary request and why the coaches line did not add up against last year.
Thanked administrators and staff for preparing the budget presentations.

votes.motion: Approve regular session minutes of November 16

what_happened.line: The School Committee heard FY19 budget requests from the primary school, Turkey Hill, middle school, high school, special services and athletics; no budget was voted.
Requests discussed include added teachers, assistant principals, paraprofessionals, a social worker and associate coaches, with questions from members.
A resident questioned whether the athletic coaches line was consistent with last year after the athletic director pay was separated out.
The superintendent agreed to look into the athletic coaches line and repost a corrected cover sheet.
A topic on a sign-up deadline policy for extracurriculars was set for future discussion and sent to the policy subcommittee.

why_it_matters: These requests are the starting point for the FY19 school budget, which feeds the town budget, mostly taxes, and the Town Meeting vote residents will be asked to take.
The athletic coaches line is being corrected, so the figures in the first cover sheet may change before the budget is set.
